name: stage:wayfinder
description: A question, not a task. Closes when the answer is recorded. Research is this, not its own label.

name: stage:spec
description: A published specification. Must link to the wayfinder node it synthesises.

name: stage:ticket
description: Atomic tracer bullet. Must have a stage:spec parent. The only dispatch-eligible stage.

name: lane:empirical
description: Verified by the gate harness + ledger. Model training and evaluation are this, not their own labels.

name: bug
description: Shipped code does not do what it says.

name: enhancement
description: New capability, or an existing one made better.

name: needs-triage
description: Entry point. Leaves when it has a category and a lane.

name: needs-info
description: Waiting on the reporter. Returns to needs-triage when they answer.

name: agent-ready
description: Human-tagged. The ONLY dispatchable state. stage:ticket only. On a PR: an agent works the diff.

name: ready-for-human
description: Gate lane green, branch current, a human decides. On a PR: ready to merge.

name: needs-human
description: Cost/failure breaker tripped, or red-lane path. Runner will not touch.

name: declined
description: Killed on evidence at the wayfinder stage. Kept, not deleted - a closed option is a result.
